valuation.method: Card network and lender: forward EPS x justified P/E at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027), viewing FY2027 diluted EPS. Base FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance is $17.60-$17.90 (raised 2026-10-23, excluding the GBTG sale gain net of restructuring; GAAP $18.30-$18.60). FY2027 base EPS $20.10 is the Street consensus snapshot (about $20.1-$20.2 across TIKR, Barchart and FN2, dated variously; not company guidance), about 13% growth on the FY2026 adjusted midpoint. Share basis: Q3 2026 diluted weighted shares 674M (shares_used 670.6M in the pipeline). USD listing, no ADR conversion. Net income and buyback effects are embedded in the EPS line.

bear.driver: Consumer spending slows and credit losses rise (card fee growth and billed business cool, as the Q3 release noted a revenue miss versus consensus), premium-card investment and remediation costs cap margins, and buybacks slow. FY2027 EPS grows only about 3% on the FY2026 adjusted midpoint.

base.driver: Management's 10% revenue growth framework holds with stable provisions and continued buybacks (diluted shares down 3% y/y in Q3). EPS compounds in line with the Street's FY2027 consensus.

bull.driver: Card fees and billed business re-accelerate, Platinum refresh and merchant expansion lift revenue growth above 10%, provisions stay benign, and the multiple re-rates toward the top of its historical range.

valuation.implied_by_close: The close of $320.60 is 15.9x base FY2027 EPS of $20.10 and 18.1x FY2026 adjusted midpoint of $17.75. The mean of the three named current targets ($365, $380, $346, about $364) implies 18.1x base FY2027 EPS, or about $20.2 of EPS at 18.0x. The Yahoo aggregate mean of $364.79 (24 analysts) implies the same multiple.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $20.10 (about 6.3 pp of price return); $1 of FY2027 EPS moves it by $18 (about 5.6 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Billed business growth and card fee growth against the 10% revenue growth framework, together with the credit provision rate and the 2027 EPS path (base needs about $20 in FY2027, growth of about 13%).
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 2026 earnings and FY2027 outlook, expected in January 2027 (provider estimate; confirm on the company IR calendar).

analyst_notes: Only three named analysts were sourced, with eight dated rows (target and rating) since October 5 (partial coverage; the Yahoo aggregate has 24 analysts). Post-Q3 targets moved within a narrow band: JPMorgan's Shane cut to $360 on Oct 12 (before results) and raised to $365 on Oct 26, UBS's Najarian cut to $345 on Oct 5 and nudged to $346 on Nov 2, and Morgan Stanley's Graseck trimmed $382 to $380 on Oct 12. These three sit about 1-2% from the base case of $362 in aggregate, so the named sample does not disagree with the base case on the multiple; the gap to the Street EPS path is small. Horizons are not documented for any sampled firm, so none enter a weighted target. Other firms (BofA, Citi, Evercore, KBW, RBC, TD Cowen) were reported in Oct 2026 without verifiable analyst names and are omitted from the individual histories.
